key.name: increase-window-width
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to increase the focused window width to the next 10 percent increment of the current monitor work area.

key.name: decrease-window-width
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to decrease the focused window width to the previous 10 percent increment of the current monitor work area.

key.name: fill-work-area
key.summary: Fill the work area with the focused window
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to resize the focused window to cover the whole work area of the current monitor without maximizing it.

key.name: three-quarter-width
key.summary: Place the focused window at 75 percent width
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to resize the focused window to 75 percent of the current monitor work area width and its full height, and move it to the right edge, or to the left edge if it is already at the right one.
